confirmation_policy_reason: operator explicitly instructed steady monitor and continue until objective is 100 percent complete
content:
OBJECTIVE: MIM-LAB-AWARENESS-HUMAN-INTERACTION-V1

MIM, resume the operator's active lab-awareness objective now. A completed growth/self-health or idle objective is not success for this operator objective.

Required behavior:
- detect humans/activity in the lab using current sensor evidence
- initiate voice TTS interaction when Dave or another human is present
- remember interactions and human names; Dave is primary operator when identified
- identify visible lab objects and ask about unknown objects without fabricating labels
- cycle all available cameras, including the arm camera, using safe existing routines only
- continue by creating MIM-owned next objectives until every success criterion is proven

TOD role: monitor and evaluate only. TOD converts stalls, drift, or false completion into learning objectives and guidance. TOD/Codex must not implement the camera/TTS/hardware work for MIM.
task: MIM-owned execution: resume lab awareness, human interaction, object inquiry, memory, and all-camera cycling until every success criterion is proven with fresh artifacts.
bounded_change: No code patch requested from TOD/Codex. MIM should use its own runtime capabilities to inventory sensors, cycle cameras, detect humans/objects, initiate TTS, and record memory evidence.
expected_evidence: fresh per-device camera and microphone inventory with openability and failure reasons
fresh per-camera cycle evidence including arm camera status
fresh human presence event and TTS action record
fresh interaction memory record with human name handling and Dave primary-operator binding
fresh object inventory plus unknown-object inquiry evidence
explicit all-success-criteria checklist with every item passed before completion
acceptance_criteria: MIM detects Dave or another human in the lab and records current sensor evidence.
MIM initiates a voice TTS interaction with the human without waiting for typed input.
MIM records the interaction for future reference and stores/reuses known human names.
MIM records Dave as primary operator when Dave is identified.
MIM identifies visible known objects and asks about unknown objects.
MIM cycles all available cameras, including the arm camera, and records current evidence for each camera.
MIM publishes a completion artifact only after all criteria are true.

failure_policy.if_blocked: publish blocked_with_inspection evidence naming exact missing device/API/permission/safety blocker and create the next MIM-owned repair objective
failure_policy.if_drift_to_growth_or_idle: return to this operator objective before doing idle growth work

do_not_do_for_mim: do not claim success from service health alone
